name: IconButton
description: Runs an action or toggles state from an icon in toolbars and table rows.

children.description: Icon element rendered inside the button

variant.description: ghost is transparent at rest; soft is the neutral tint shared with Button soft

size.description: Square control on the one track: xs 24, sm 28, md 32, lg 40

pressed.description: Controlled pressed state; any of pressed, defaultPressed or onPressedChange makes the button a toggle with aria-pressed

defaultPressed.description: Initial pressed state of an uncontrolled toggle

onPressedChange.description: Called with the next pressed state

pending.description: Work is running: aria-busy, presses ignored, a spinner replaces the glyph after a second

render.description: Replace the rendered element, e.g. an anchor or a router link; a rendered anchor keeps link semantics and takes the look, pending and disabled behaviour

aria-label.description: Accessible action name when no labelled-by relationship is available

aria-labelledby.description: ID reference for an external accessible action label

when: Toolbars and top bars where text buttons crowd
Row actions too narrow for a label
Toggle actions that show a pressed state
whenNot: The action needs a visible label — use Button
It flips a persistent setting — use Switch
The icon is decorative — use Icon
guidelines: aria-label or aria-labelledby is required, every time
The only icon-only control: never a Button wrapping a lone icon
ghost for ordinary toolbar actions; soft when it needs a touch more weight
pressed only for real toggle state; it paints the selection wash and ring
xs for in-row actions; it still reaches the hit-area floor
Keep icon meaning obvious, or pair it with a Tooltip
accessibility: Name the action, not the icon: "Delete row", not "Trash"
Pressed state is exposed via aria-pressed
Hit target stays at least 24px even at size="xs"

examples.name: Toolbar action
examples.description: Icon carries the action; the label lives in aria-label.
examples.code:
import { Plus as PlusIcon } from '@phosphor-icons/react';

<IconButton aria-label="Add item">
  <PlusIcon aria-hidden />
</IconButton>

examples.name: Variants
examples.code:
import { Plus as PlusIcon } from '@phosphor-icons/react';
import { Stack } from '@/components/Stack';

<Stack direction="row" gap="sm" align="center">
  <IconButton aria-label="Add item" variant="ghost">
    <PlusIcon aria-hidden />
  </IconButton>
  <IconButton aria-label="Add item" variant="soft">
    <PlusIcon aria-hidden />
  </IconButton>
</Stack>

examples.name: Sizes
examples.description: xs for in-row actions, lg for primary chrome.
examples.code:
import { Plus as PlusIcon } from '@phosphor-icons/react';
import { Stack } from '@/components/Stack';

<Stack direction="row" gap="sm" align="center">
  <IconButton aria-label="Add item" size="xs">
    <PlusIcon aria-hidden />
  </IconButton>
  <IconButton aria-label="Add item" size="sm">
    <PlusIcon aria-hidden />
  </IconButton>
  <IconButton aria-label="Add item" size="md">
    <PlusIcon aria-hidden />
  </IconButton>
  <IconButton aria-label="Add item" size="lg">
    <PlusIcon aria-hidden />
  </IconButton>
</Stack>

examples.name: Toggle
examples.description: A real toggle: the pressed state is owned by the caller and reported through aria-pressed.

examples.name: Disabled
examples.description: Unavailable action, out of the tab order.
examples.code:
import { Trash as TrashIcon } from '@phosphor-icons/react';

<IconButton aria-label="Delete row" disabled>
  <TrashIcon aria-hidden />
</IconButton>

examples.name: Pending
examples.description: Work is running; the spinner takes the glyph's place.
examples.code:
import { ArrowsClockwise } from '@phosphor-icons/react';

<IconButton aria-label="Syncing" pending>
  <ArrowsClockwise aria-hidden />
</IconButton>

relations.note: Use Button when the action should have a visible text label or broader layout variants
Icon supplies the visual glyph rendered inside IconButton

propsSummary: pressed/defaultPressed/onPressedChange - a real toggle exposed with aria-pressed
aria-label or aria-labelledby - required accessible name
